blocks.text: The stack is a FastAPI RAG API with an in-process embedding model, Postgres + pgvector for documents and vectors, optional Qdrant behind a `VECTOR_BACKEND` switch, and a one-shot migrate job, all on one private Compose network.

blocks.src: generate: host → 127.0.0.1:8000 → api (FastAPI + embedding model, hf_cache volume) on a "backend" network; api → db (Postgres 17 + pgvector, pgdata volume) and → qdrant (qdrant_storage volume); one-shot migrate → db; api → external LLM API; optional ollama under a profile
blocks.caption: Capstone topology.

items: Ingest: chunk → embed (batch) → write chunk rows → upsert vectors keyed by chunk ID.
Query: embed question (same model) → ANN top-k → fetch chunks → prompt LLM → answer with citations.
Only localhost-bound ports; services talk by name.
Schema owned by migrations; model name and dimension are validated config.
Deterministic chunk IDs make re-ingest an idempotent upsert across stores.

blocks.text: Q: "Walk me through your containerized RAG architecture." A: "A FastAPI service with an in-process embedding model, Postgres with pgvector (Qdrant optional), and a one-shot migration job, all on a private Compose network. Named volumes hold state, only the API is published on localhost, and the same image runs migrations and the API."

items: api + db + optional vector DB + migrate job.
Same model at ingest and query.
